[[Term limit]]s prevented incumbent Governor [[Ben Nelson]], a [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democrat]], from seeking a third term in office. [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] nominee [[Mike Johanns]], [[List of mayors of Lincoln, Nebraska|Mayor of Lincoln]], defeated Democratic nominee, attorney Bill Hoppner. {{As of|2026}}, this was the last gubernatorial election in Nebraska in which the margin of victory was within single digits.
